principle: No output is trustworthy unless population, denominator, calculation, statistical meaning, evidence quality, policy boundary and UI wording agree.

population_contracts.historical: all validated source rows including explicit snapshots
population_contracts.unknown_outcome: unrecognized Attrition remains missing and cannot enable predictive training

four_fifths_ratio.meaning: favorable_outcome_rate divided by highest favorable rate

quality_of_hire.meaning: observational association and configurable composite screening

survival.meaning: cohort time-to-event survival from defined origin

predictive_contracts.training: raw rows split before learned preprocessing
predictive_contracts.holdout: untouched by fitted preprocessing and SMOTE
predictive_contracts.uncertainty: non-calibrated tree disagreement is not exposed as confidence interval

governance_controls: critical fields map only by exact/direct aliases
no individual experience scoring or manager ranking
no employee succession or stagnation ranking
no individual compensation outlier or compa-ratio lists
headcount reduction and risk-targeted intervention scenarios disabled
causal intervention API disabled until identification design exists
forecasts require genuine repeated dated observations
agent evidence quality and coverage remain separate
explicit_assumptions: observational HR data does not identify causal intervention effects without additional design assumptions
scenario cost and response parameters require organization-specific validation
configured composite scores such as experience or quality-of-hire are local heuristics unless separately validated
predictive model artifacts are currently process-local and require durable artifact persistence for multi-process production deployment
remaining_non_blocking_debt: rename backward-compatible turnover_rate fields in a future breaking API version
rename backward-compatible best_predictors and equity_scores fields in a future breaking API version
durable predictive artifact persistence across process restart
remove legacy engine methods that are now unreachable behind governed API boundaries
